changed: Closure inferred from committed close records (feature passes with this task's evidence, handoff, progress entry), so an unrelated untracked file, a new phase plan or a later commit no longer reopens a closed task in a checkout without a local record; amend-scope keeps a task open.

rulings.ruling: Without a local record, the committed close records decide closure
rulings.cost_if_wrong: in a fresh checkout a task with uncommitted fix work after its closure is treated as closed until refresh-task reopens it
